newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgaria to cut main interest rate to 47.28 pct/yr.
newsitem.headline: Bulgaria to cut main interest rate to 47.28 pct/yr.

text.p: The Bulgarian National Bank (BNB) will cut its main interest rate to 47.28 percent annually from 48.72 percent, commercial bank dealers said on Thursday.
"The central bank informed us that it will set its main rate at 47.28 percent annually from Monday," a dealer told Reuters.
BNB officials were not immediately available for comment. An official statement could be expected later on Thursday.
Dealers said the new main interest rate would give 59.0 percent effective annual interest rate calculated through accumulation of the monthly accruals.
The rate cut reflected lower yields on four-week discount T-bill issues auctioned since Friday, dealers said.

The central bank adjusts its main rate weekly to the weighted average effective monthly yield on Finance ministry's four-week discount T-bills sold daily from Friday through Thursday at the primary auctions.
The average yield to maturity on four-week maturities auctioned since Friday ranged between 3.48-3.81 percent, down from 3.76-3.81 percent the week before. -- Sofia Newsroom, (++359-2) 911 88
